I will keep this sorghum the same way I trust from here in Nsanje. I do not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot because cash is tight, and on this small piece I would rather use my own seed and a bit of manure if I have enough at home. I will not spray because most of us here do not spray sorghum, and I will wait for the rains instead of irrigating.
